observed: On SubKit v12.1.6, two independent fresh CLI processes ran `files upload export.bin --no-dedup --json` after an ordinary upload of the same bytes. Each forced command exited 0; the isolated receiver recorded a 200 batch-create response with dedup=true and a subsequent metadata GET, but recorded zero additional content-transfer bytes.
scope: Signed Linux CLI client behavior only. The HTTP receiver was a simulated loopback provider implementing the released batch-create, transfer, finalize, and file-readback contract; no production Engine was used.

result.forced_uploads: 2/2 exited 0 with zero new transferred bytes

limitation: This evidence does not establish production Engine behavior or server-side persistence; it establishes the released CLI request sequence against the simulated contract.
